title: Efficient specialist intelligence
banner: DRAFT TEMPLATE - NOT FROZEN, NOT APPROVED, NO RESULT. Authorizes no training, GPU use, provider call, spend or protected-corpus access.

hypothesis.text: For a small founder-chosen set of workflows, a small tuned model with the ORNEUR system (arm 4) is non-inferior in quality (one-sided margin) to a larger base with the same system, at no more than half the cost per correct answer on the same hardware class, and beats its own same-size base with the system (arm 3) by at least the pre-registered minimum detectable effect.

additional_controls.definition: larger base + identical ORNEUR system at the next size class that fits the frozen hardware plan (cost/quality reference); a different arm family compared on cost, never part of the T2-vs-B2 identity check

arms.identity_rule: T2 and B2 must share a byte-identical system_config_hash (prompts, retrieval config, tool set, decoding, budgets, code SHA); they differ only in model identity (enforced by orca.evalinfra.arms).

options: code repair validated by hermetic unit tests
technical Q&A with citations over a fixed corpus
multilingual instruction following / translation faithfulness (languages TO_BE_DECIDED_BY_FOUNDER)

hidden_categories: held-out repositories / templates / documents / languages unseen by any generator
adversarially messy inputs (OCR noise, truncated files)
degenerate inputs that should be rejected

endpoints.note: one per chosen workflow declared up front; at most one counted in the programme-level primary family, the others exploratory

cost_model.definition: (GPU-seconds x price + retrieval cost) / correct answers, measured under identical load

multiplicity.family: programme primary family (<= 4 primaries across C1, C2, C3 plus one safety endpoint)

failure_criteria: cost advantage below 2x or vanishes at realistic utilization
gain only on templates present in training generators (leak check)
T2 minus B2 below 5 points (use the larger base instead)
negative_result_policy: A failed criterion is recorded as a negative result with the same prominence as a positive one and the training objective is dropped.
blockers: founder approval of hypotheses and thresholds
measured throughput on the founder-approved hardware plan (cost model)
separate authorization for execution of model-written code (hermetic sandbox)
foundation selection by the pre-registered rule (NOT performed here)
founder authorization FINAL-2 then EXEC-1 before any training or GPU run
